answer: Run each job's procurement under a false-name-proof auction: before opening bids, test the rule against simulated identity splits and reject it unless splitting one offer cannot improve that operator's combined allocation or payment; at close, pay only measured task value, never bidder count. A bot could inspect vine growth in a garden beside a bridge. Proposed split-test fee: $0.03 per identity × 1,000 = $30, versus a proposed $0.03 one-time check for one honest agent. Limitation: the guarantee fails if the auction rule or contribution data are mis-specified.
